messages:
anya: Heads-up — I'm proposing a new routing rule to prefer newer model variants only when compatibility >= 1.2 for given tenant. Thoughts?
cheng: @anya quick q: is compatibility semantic (tokenizer+output shape) or runtime ABI? :thinking: 
anya: runtime ABI + semantic contract. Example: deterministic output types, no shape changes. We need to avoid silent failures when model outputs differ.
ben: idea: add `compatibility_level` field to routing DSL. If requested model alias has pinned version incompatible -> fallback chain. Keep priority: exact pin > header pin > alias weight.
elena: Can we short-circuit if quota exhausted? Routing should consider route quota before selecting heavy model.
marc: +1. Also need telemetry - emit "route_selection_reason" with fields: chosen_model, reason, compat_score, quota_check
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary routing rule test on tenant `alpha` at 02:00 UTC, will roll for 2h
cheng: rough DSL proposal:
```
route {
  match: header("x-tenant") == "alpha"
  model_alias: "gptx-embed"
  compatibility_min: "1.2"
  fallbacks: ["gptx-embed-quant", "gptx-embed-legacy"]
}
```
ben: UX: Console should show "compatibility impact" badge and let SREs preview fallback probability from telemetry.
elena: Also add a `force_fallback_on_incompat` toggle for canary tests so we can intentionally route
anya: operational checklist: 1) API gateway support for compatibility_min 2) telemetry schema 3) console badge + preview 4) rollout flag
marc: We'll need a migration plan: default compatibility_min=0 to keep current behavior; add lint to console rules
cheng: Implementation notes: runtime will call model.metadata.compatibility_version; compare semver, if < required -> skip and record tag `compat_mismatch`
anya: Can someone take ownership of console UX? @elena?
elena: I'll own console bits. I'll add mockups in #design by EOD. :thumbsup:
ben: I'll handle gateway changes (router + unit tests). Taking ownership.
marc: I'll wire telemetry + rollout flag. I'll create a schema PR.
anya: Thanks. Can we aim for a canary this week? ops-bot says 02:00 UTC tomorrow works?
ops-bot: confirmed: canary window created: 2312349000-2312356200
anya: ok moving to design + infra tasks. (reaction: :rocket:)
